text:
Upon the eternal stone of the world so compact,

the weak, fresh trace of your naked body.

Everything is very hard and sour, it rebels, enemy,

and you rise so young and sure, so tender...


It is not true that flowers always fight silently.

They cry out their scent and die early,

while you, who are more, suffer twice as much as they do

and also die late, because you are already withering.

translation.title: Adolescents
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the contrast between the hard world, fragrant flowers, and the adolescent body's withering.
